title: Stargate staff came from Sidney Gottlieb's Technical Services Staff

tellings.quote: know that actually a lot of original people who were on that program came from Sydney Gotaut's technical staff services.

plain: Many of the first people on Stargate, a US government program run from the 1970s to the 1990s at the Stanford Research Institute in California to study remote viewing (trying to describe distant places with the mind alone), are said to have come from a government technical services staff run by a man named Sidney Gottlieb. Michels says this himself, without naming a source, on an episode with a philosopher named Jason Jorjani. If true, it would tie the psychic program to an older and more secretive line of government work.
